# POINT · FACE — Expert Facials in Uluwatu, Bali

> POINT · FACE is an expert facial studio in Uluwatu, Bali, with two studios in Ungasan and Bingin. Korean Hydrafacials, HydroJelly facials, Balinese natural facials and face-sculpting massages (Kobido, Buccal, Gua Sha). Every treatment starts with a free skin analysis using AI-powered diagnostic technology. Rated 4.9/5 on Fresha, with more than 2,000 clients welcomed.

## Which facial should I book?
- Instant glow, hydration, glass skin: Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift (signature).
- Fine lines, firmness: Advanced Collagen Booster or Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift.
- Acne, congestion: K-Balance Acne Clear.
- Sunburn, after surf, sensitive skin: Cryo Skin Reset or PDRN Cellular Repair.
- Pigmentation, dark spots: Bright & Pigment Correct.
- Dry or sensitive skin, natural products: Hydrating Ritual (Rose & Aloe).
- Jaw tension, puffiness, contour: Buccal Massage, Kobido.

- [Anti-Aging & Firming Facials in Uluwatu, Bali: Fine Lines, Wrinkles & Sagging](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/fine-lines-wrinkles-bali/): Prevent the signs of aging, boost collagen and keep the skin from sagging, without needles. Our anti-aging facials combine Korean peptides, radiofrequency, microcurrent and red LED to firm the skin and soften the look of lines.
- [Acne, Breakouts & Blackheads Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/acne-breakouts-bali/): Humidity, sweat, sunscreen and salt water — Bali is tough on congested skin. Our acne facials deep-clean pores, clear blackheads, rebalance oil and calm inflammation without stripping your skin.
- [Dehydrated Skin Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/dehydrated-skin-bali/): Tight, dull, flaky — yet still oily? That is dehydration, the most common skin concern we see in Uluwatu. Our hydrating facials flood the skin with water and repair the barrier that keeps it in.
- [After-Sun & Post-Surf Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/sun-damaged-skin-bali/): Surf sessions at Bingin, afternoons at Padang Padang, sunsets on the cliffs. Our after-sun facials cool, calm and repair skin that has seen a lot of sun.
- [Pigmentation & Dark Spot Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/pigmentation-dark-spots-bali/): Sun spots, post-acne marks, an uneven tone. Our Korean brightening protocol targets pigmentation with vitamin C and niacinamide — and helps you protect your results in the Bali sun.
- [Glass Skin Facial in Uluwatu, Bali — For Dull, Tired Skin](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/dull-tired-skin-glass-skin/): Glass skin is the Korean ideal of skin so smooth, hydrated and clear it reflects light like glass. It is not about make-up — it is about hydration, texture and a healthy barrier.
- [Facials for Sensitive & Reactive Skin in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/sensitive-reactive-skin/): Redness, stinging, heat, reactions to new products. Sensitive skin needs facials that calm and repair — never strip.
- [Face Sculpting Massage in Uluwatu — Puffiness & Jaw Tension](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/puffiness-jaw-tension/): A clenched jaw, a puffy morning face, features that look tired. Our sculpting massages work the muscles and lymph for a defined, relaxed face — naturally.

## Journal
- [Best Hydrafacial in Bali: What Makes a Great Hydrafacial (and Where to Book in Uluwatu)](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/best-hydrafacial-bali/): The best Hydrafacial in Bali starts with a real skin analysis, uses a multi-function Hydrafacial system (hydrodermabrasion, extraction, ultrasonic and oxygen infusion, radiofrequency, LED), infuses actives chosen for your concern, and ends with aftercare adapted to sun and sea. In Uluwatu, POINT · FACE offers five Korean Hydrafacials at both studios, three HydroJelly Hydrafacials in Ungasan and Korean Body Hydrafacials in Bingin.
- [Best Things to Do in Uluwatu & Bali (and Where to Get a Facial)](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/things-to-do-uluwatu-bali/): In Uluwatu, watch the sunset and Kecak fire dance at Uluwatu Temple, spend your days on the beaches of Bingin, Padang Padang, Dreamland, Suluban and Melasti, surf or watch the surfers, and have a seafood dinner on Jimbaran Bay. From the Bukit, day trips reach Ubud, Nusa Dua and the islands. Between beach days, book a facial at POINT · FACE in Ungasan or Bingin to repair sun-exposed skin.
- [Korean Skincare Ingredients: Benefits of Snail Mucin, Centella, PDRN & More](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/korean-skincare-ingredients-benefits/): Korean skincare is built on gentle, hydrating, barrier-friendly actives. Snail mucin and hyaluronic acid hydrate and plump, centella asiatica calms and repairs, niacinamide evens tone and regulates oil, peptides and PDRN support firmness and recovery, BHA clears pores, and vitamin C brightens. At POINT · FACE we infuse them with Hydrafacial technology, using COSRX, SKIN1004, Mediheal, Medicube and Beauty of Joseon.
- [Post-Surf Skin Care in Uluwatu: Protect & Repair Your Skin](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/post-surf-skin-care-uluwatu/): Surfers' skin takes a triple hit in Uluwatu: intense equatorial UV amplified by reflection off the water, salt that dries the surface and wind that strips moisture. Protect it with a water-resistant SPF 50 and zinc, rinse and hydrate after every session, and book a cooling, repairing facial — such as the Cryo Skin Reset or the PDRN Cellular Repair — every 2–3 weeks.
- [Kobido vs Gua Sha: Which Face Massage Should You Choose?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/kobido-vs-gua-sha/): Choose Kobido if you want a lifting, toning effect: it uses fast, rhythmic lifting motions and percussive tapping and is known as the "natural facelift". Choose Gua Sha if you want relaxation and gentle drainage: smooth stones glide over the face to release tension and depuff. For deep jaw tension, add a Buccal Massage.
- [Buccal Massage in Bali: What It Is, What to Expect & Results](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/buccal-massage-what-to-expect/): Buccal massage is an intra-oral facial massage: with gloved hands, the therapist works the jaw and cheek muscles from inside the mouth as well as outside, reaching deep muscles a regular face massage cannot. It releases jaw tension from clenching, drains puffiness and gives a more sculpted contour — with no needles or filler. At POINT · FACE it takes 15 minutes and can be added to any facial.
- [What Is a PDRN (Salmon DNA) Facial? Benefits, Results & Who It's For](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/what-is-pdrn-salmon-dna-facial/): PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a purified DNA fragment, usually extracted from salmon, used in Korean dermatology to support skin repair and regeneration. In a non-invasive PDRN facial it is applied topically in serums and masks and driven deeper with ultrasound — no needles — to calm redness, strengthen the skin barrier and help stressed skin recover.
- [Best Facial in Uluwatu: How to Choose the Right Facial Studio](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/best-facial-uluwatu-guide/): The best facial in Uluwatu is the one matched to your skin: look for a studio that starts with a skin analysis, offers both technology-led and natural facials, uses recognised skincare, publishes clear all-inclusive prices and has strong recent reviews. POINT · FACE has two studios — Uluwatu Ungasan and Uluwatu Bingin — specialised in Korean Hydrafacials, Balinese natural facials and sculpting face massages.
- [How Often Should You Get a Facial in Bali's Climate?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/how-often-facial-bali-climate/): In Bali's hot, humid and sunny climate, most people benefit from a professional facial every 3–4 weeks — roughly one skin-renewal cycle. For a specific concern such as acne or pigmentation, a series of 3 sessions spaced 2–3 weeks apart works best, followed by maintenance every 4–8 weeks. If you are visiting, book one facial early in your trip and one before you fly home.
- [Why Does My Skin Get Dehydrated in Bali — and Which Facial Helps?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/why-skin-gets-dehydrated-in-bali/): Skin gets dehydrated in Bali because of a chain of stressors: dry cabin air on the flight, strong UV, salt water, wind and nights in air-conditioning. They pull water from the outer layers and weaken the barrier. A hydrating facial that infuses humectants and repairs the barrier — such as a Korean Hydrafacial or a PDRN repair facial — restores comfort and glow in one session.
- [Korean Hydrafacial vs Hydrafacial vs Manual Facial: Which Is Best for You?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/hydrafacial-vs-korean-facial/): A classic Hydrafacial is a device-led protocol: hydrodermabrasion to cleanse, extract and infuse serums. A Korean Hydrafacial uses the same technology but adds a multi-step Korean skincare ritual — layered K-beauty actives, masks and massage — for a hydrated "glass skin" finish. A manual facial uses hands and natural products only: more sensory and relaxing, with gentler, shorter-lived results. For visible glow and deep cleansing in Bali's climate, the Korean Hydrafacial gives the best of both.
- [What Is Glass Skin — and Can a Facial Give It to You?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/what-is-glass-skin/): Glass skin is a Korean beauty term for skin so hydrated, smooth and clear that it looks translucent and reflects light like glass. It rests on three pillars: deep hydration, refined texture (clean pores, no build-up) and a healthy barrier. A Korean Hydrafacial delivers all three in one session — the glow is visible immediately and lasts about a week.
- [Pre-Wedding Facial Timeline for a Bali Wedding](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/pre-wedding-facial-timeline-bali/): For a wedding in Bali, start 2–3 months before with a series of targeted facials (acne, pigmentation or firmness), keep a monthly hydrating facial, then book your final glow facial 2–5 days before the ceremony — never the day before. In Uluwatu, our Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift or Ultimate Glass Skin plus a Buccal Massage give maximum lift and glow with no redness on the day.

# FULL CONTENT

## FAQ
**Where is POINT · FACE located?**
We have two studios in Uluwatu, Bali: POINT · FACE Uluwatu Ungasan (Jl. Toya Ning II No. 99, Ungasan) and POINT · FACE Uluwatu Bingin (Bingin Downtown Avenue, Jl. Pantai Cemongkak No. 9, Pecatu, in the Bingin surf village). HydroJelly Hydrafacials are exclusive to Ungasan and Korean Body Hydrafacials to Bingin.

**How do I book a facial?**
Book on WhatsApp — choose Uluwatu Ungasan or Uluwatu Bingin — or book online on Fresha. We recommend booking 1–3 days in advance in high season.

**What is included in every treatment?**
Every treatment starts with a free skin analysis using AI-powered diagnostic technology: it measures hydration, oil, pores, pigmentation and sensitivity, so your therapist can adapt the facial to your skin on the day.

**Do your prices include tax and service?**
Yes. All prices include the 15% government tax and service charge. No additional fees apply.

**What is the difference between a facial and a Hydrafacial?**
A traditional facial uses manual techniques and natural products for a gentle, sensory ritual. A Hydrafacial uses technology — hydrodermabrasion, ultrasound, radiofrequency, LED — for deeper cleansing and more visible results.

**Which skincare brands do you use?**
Korean brands COSRX, SKIN1004, Beauty of Joseon, Mediheal and Medicube for our Korean facials, and Balinese natural skincare from Utama Spice & Embun for our Balinese rituals.

**Which facial is best for my first visit?**
For most skin types, the Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift — our signature. If unsure, your therapist will recommend the best option after the skin analysis.

**Is there any downtime?**
No. Our facials are non-invasive. Avoid sun, surfing, sauna and intense exercise for 24–48 hours and apply SPF 50.

**Can I book with a friend or partner?**
Yes — our Duo Package includes two Ultimate Korean Glass Skin treatments for IDR 2,250,000, in shared or separate cabins.

**Do you offer packages?**
Yes: 3-session packages on facials, Hydrafacials and face massages, at 20–30% off, valid for 5 months.

## Treatment details
### Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift
The signature POINT · FACE experience. We combine Hydrafacial hydrodermabrasion with Korean actives — peptides, snail mucin, propolis, niacinamide and centella — infused with ultrasound, then finish with oxygen, high-frequency, cold hammer and dual red & green LED. Skin is decongested, plumped with water and visibly lifted, with that luminous "glass skin" reflection Korean skincare is known for. Features COSRX, SKIN1004 and Beauty of Joseon.
- Ingredients: 6 Peptide Skin Booster, Snail Mucin, Hyaluronic Acid, Propolis + Niacinamide, BHA, Centella Asiatica
- Technologies: Hydrodermabrasion, Ultrasonic infusion, Oxygen therapy, LED light therapy (red & green), High Frequency therapy, Cold Hammer
- Results: Immediate glow & plump effect, Refined, decongested pores, Glass-like skin texture, Deep, lasting hydration
- For best results: 1 session for instant glow · 3 sessions for long-term skin transformation.
- Q: How long does the glass-skin glow last? A: The glow and plumpness are visible immediately and usually last 5–7 days. For lasting change in texture and hydration, we recommend a series of 3 sessions spaced 2–3 weeks apart.
- Q: Is it suitable for sensitive skin? A: Yes. Your therapist adapts the exfoliation and actives after the complimentary skin analysis. Let us know about any reactivity, retinoid use or recent sunburn before your session.
- Q: Can I book it with a friend? A: Yes — the Duo Package includes two Ultimate Korean Glass Skin treatments for IDR 2,250,000, in shared or separate cabins.

### Advanced Collagen Booster
Designed as a monthly "skin gym" session. After hydrodermabrasion we infuse a triple collagen serum and peptides, then work the facial contours with microcurrent sculpting and radiofrequency to support firmness and elasticity. Red LED finishes the treatment to support collagen production. Features COSRX, SKIN1004, Mediheal and Medicube.
- Ingredients: Triple Collagen Serum, Collagen Mask, Collagen Cream, 6 Peptide Skin Booster, Snail Mucin & Retinol, Centella Asiatica
- Technologies: Hydrodermabrasion, Ultrasonic infusion, Oxygen therapy, LED light therapy (red), High Frequency therapy, Microcurrent sculpting
- Results: Immediate glow & plump effect, Reduced look of fine lines, Improved elasticity, Sculpted jawline & cheekbones
- For best results: Recommended as a monthly collagen-booster treatment.
- Q: Does microcurrent hurt? A: No. Most clients feel a light tingling or nothing at all. The current is very low and the session is relaxing.
- Q: How is it different from the Caviar facial? A: The Collagen Booster focuses on firmness with microcurrent and peptides and is ideal as a monthly routine. The Caviar Luxury facial is more indulgent, with caviar infusion, RF lifting, an eye ultrasonic step and a HydroJelly mask — perfect before an event.

### PDRN Cellular Repair (Salmon DNA)
PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a DNA fragment derived from salmon, widely used in Korean dermatology for its skin-repairing properties. In this facial we use topical PDRN serums and a Rose PDRN mask — no needles — combined with gentle hydrodermabrasion, ultrasonic infusion, oxygen and red LED to calm redness, strengthen the barrier and help skin bounce back. Features COSRX, SKIN1004, Mediheal and Medicube.
- Ingredients: PDRN — Salmon DNA, PDRN Pink Peptide Serum, Rose PDRN Mask, Hyaluronic Acid, 6 Peptide Skin Booster, Centella Asiatica
- Technologies: Hydrodermabrasion, Ultrasonic infusion, Oxygen therapy, LED light therapy (red), High Frequency therapy, Microcurrent sculpting
- Results: Stronger skin barrier, Reduced sensitivity & redness, Deep skin recovery, Healthier, resilient skin
- For best results: Ideal after sun exposure, stress, long-haul travel or skin damage.
- Q: Is the PDRN facial an injection? A: No. This is a non-invasive facial: PDRN is applied topically in serums and masks and pushed deeper with ultrasound. There are no needles and no downtime.
- Q: Is PDRN safe if I am allergic to fish? A: Please tell us before booking. If you have a fish or salmon allergy we will recommend an alternative such as the Cryo Skin Reset or the Hydrating Ritual.

### K-Balance Acne Clear
A deep pore-cleansing protocol for humid-climate skin. Double cleansing, AHA/BHA exfoliation and Hydrafacial vortex extraction decongest pores, followed by careful manual extraction where needed. Ultrasonic infusion of niacinamide and tea tree, antibacterial high frequency, cold hammer and red & blue LED calm breakouts and rebalance oil. Features COSRX, SKIN1004 and Mediheal.
- Ingredients: BHA (Salicylic Acid), AHA/BHA, Niacinamide 15, Tea-Trica (Tea Tree), Centella Asiatica, Hyaluronic Acid
- Technologies: Hydrodermabrasion, Ultrasonic infusion, Manual extraction, LED light therapy (red & blue), High Frequency therapy, Cold Hammer
- Results: Deep pore cleansing, Regulated sebum, Clearer skin & fewer breakouts, Less inflammation
- For best results: For active acne: a series of 3 sessions spaced 2–3 weeks apart, then one session every 2 months as maintenance.
- Q: Will my skin purge after the facial? A: Some clients notice a few small spots surfacing in the 48 hours after a deep-cleansing facial — it is congestion leaving the pores. It settles quickly when you follow the aftercare.
- Q: Can I go in the sea after an acne facial? A: We recommend waiting 24–48 hours before surfing, swimming or intense sun exposure, and always using SPF 50.

### Vitamin C Sunshine Glow
A sunshine boost for tired, sun-dulled skin. - Results: Natural, non-invasive lifting effect, Reduced puffiness & congestion, Firmer, illuminated complexion

### Buccal Massage
Buccal massage reaches the deep muscles that a regular face massage cannot. Wearing gloves, your therapist works the masseter, buccinator and cheek muscles from inside the mouth as well as outside, releasing jaw tension from clenching and stress, draining lymph and redefining facial contours — no needles, no filler. Add it to any facial or Hydrafacial.
- Ingredients: —
- Technologies: Intra-oral massage (gloved), External sculpting, Lymphatic drainage
- Results: Releases jaw tension & facial tightness, Enhanced natural contour, Improved circulation & glow, Reduced puffiness & muscle stiffness
- For best results: Add 15 minutes to any facial; ideal for jaw clenchers and before events.
- Q: Does buccal massage hurt? A: It is intense rather than painful — you feel deep pressure in the jaw and cheek muscles. Your therapist adapts the pressure to you throughout.
- Q: Who should avoid buccal massage? A: Avoid it with recent dental work or surgery, mouth ulcers, active cold sores or an infection in the mouth. Let us know about braces or jaw conditions before booking.

The best Hydrafacial in Bali starts with a real skin analysis, uses a multi-function Hydrafacial system (hydrodermabrasion, extraction, ultrasonic and oxygen infusion, radiofrequency, LED), infuses actives chosen for your concern, and ends with aftercare adapted to sun and sea. In Uluwatu, POINT · FACE offers five Korean Hydrafacials at both studios, three HydroJelly Hydrafacials in Ungasan and Korean Body Hydrafacials in Bingin.

Our systems cleanse (hydrodermabrasion, ultrasonic scrubber, vacuum and spot extraction), infuse (oxygen, ultrasound, eye ultrasound), lift (radiofrequency, microcurrent, multipolar lifting) and calm (high frequency, cryo, LED). ### Best Things to Do in Uluwatu & Bali (and Where to Get a Facial)
In Uluwatu, watch the sunset and Kecak fire dance at Uluwatu Temple, spend your days on the beaches of Bingin, Padang Padang, Dreamland, Suluban and Melasti, surf or watch the surfers, and have a seafood dinner on Jimbaran Bay. From the Bukit, day trips reach Ubud, Nusa Dua and the islands. Between beach days, book a facial at POINT · FACE in Ungasan or Bingin to repair sun-exposed skin.

Uluwatu Temple and the Kecak dance Pura Luhur Uluwatu sits on a cliff high above the Indian Ocean. Come in the late afternoon for the view and stay for the Kecak fire dance at sunset. Keep sunglasses and phones close: the temple monkeys are famous for snatching them. The beaches of the Bukit Bingin — a cliffside village with stairs down to a reef beach and warungs. Our Bingin studio is a few minutes away. Padang Padang — a small, photogenic cove reached through a gap in the rocks. Dreamland — a wide sandy beach, one of the easier spots for a swim when the sea is calm. Suluban — a beach hidden in a cave below Uluwatu's famous surf break. Melasti — white sand framed by dramatic limestone cliffs, close to our Ungasan studio. Waves and currents can be strong: check conditions, swim where locals swim and respect red flags. ### Korean Skincare Ingredients: Benefits of Snail Mucin, Centella, PDRN & More
Korean skincare is built on gentle, hydrating, barrier-friendly actives. Snail mucin and hyaluronic acid hydrate and plump, centella asiatica calms and repairs, niacinamide evens tone and regulates oil, peptides and PDRN support firmness and recovery, BHA clears pores, and vitamin C brightens. At POINT · FACE we infuse them with Hydrafacial technology, using COSRX, SKIN1004, Mediheal, Medicube and Beauty of Joseon.

Why Korean skincare works so well in Bali Korean formulas favour lightweight textures, layering and barrier care over harsh actives. That suits a hot, humid, sunny climate: skin gets hydration without heaviness, and calming ingredients help it cope with sun, salt water and air-conditioning. Snail mucin Snail secretion filtrate is rich in glycoproteins and hyaluronic acid. It hydrates, softens and supports skin recovery, which gives the plump, dewy look of glass skin. We use COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence in our Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift and Vitamin C Sunshine Glow. Centella asiatica Also called cica or tiger grass, centella is the hero of SKIN1004. It is known for calming redness, supporting the skin barrier and helping irritated skin recover, which makes it ideal after sun or breakouts. It appears in almost all of our Korean Hydrafacials. Niacinamide Vitamin B3 is a multitasker: it helps regulate oil, refine the look of pores, even skin tone and strengthen the barrier. It is a key active in K-Balance Acne Clear and Bright & Pigment Correct. BHA and tea tree Salicylic acid (BHA) is oil-soluble, so it cleans inside the pore and helps clear blackheads. Paired with tea tree (SKIN1004 Tea-Trica), it is the base of our acne and body protocols, including the Signature Back Acne & Pore Clear. Peptides and collagen Peptides are short chains of amino acids that support the look of firmness and elasticity. Our Advanced Collagen Booster combines a 6-peptide skin booster with a triple collagen serum, then uses microcurrent and red LED. PDRN (salmon DNA) PDRN is a regenerative ingredient popular in Korean dermatology. Applied topically and infused with ultrasound, it supports barrier repair and recovery. Read our full guide: What is a PDRN facial? Vitamin C Vitamin C is an antioxidant that helps brighten dull skin and even the look of dark spots. Our Vitamin C Sunshine Glow uses Mediheal vitamin C with SKIN1004 Tone Brightening Capsule Cream. Always pair it with SPF 50 in Bali. How we choose for your skin Every treatment starts with a free AI-powered skin analysis. Your therapist then selects the actives and technologies your skin needs that day. Not sure where to start? See our skin concern guides.

### Post-Surf Skin Care in Uluwatu: Protect & Repair Your Skin
Surfers' skin takes a triple hit in Uluwatu: intense equatorial UV amplified by reflection off the water, salt that dries the surface and wind that strips moisture. Protect it with a water-resistant SPF 50 and zinc, rinse and hydrate after every session, and book a cooling, repairing facial — such as the Cryo Skin Reset or the PDRN Cellular Repair — every 2–3 weeks.

What surfing does to your skin Water reflects a significant part of UV back to your face, so you get sun from above and below. Sunscreen washes and rubs off. Salt water draws moisture out, and wind accelerates evaporation. The result: redness, heat, tightness, peeling, then over time sun spots and premature lines. Before the session Apply a water-resistant SPF 50 at least 15 minutes before paddling out. Add a zinc stick on the nose, cheekbones and lips. Consider a surf cap for long midday sessions. After the session Rinse your face with fresh water as soon as you can. Cleanse gently in the evening to remove zinc and sunscreen. Apply aloe or a soothing gel, then a hydrating serum and moisturiser. Avoid acids and retinol while skin is red. The best facials after surfing Cryo Skin Reset — cryo-globe massage and a Blue Glacier HydroJelly mask cool overheated skin instantly. PDRN Cellular Repair — supports the barrier after repeated sun and salt. Bright & Pigment Correct — later in your stay, to fade sun spots. Our Bingin studio is minutes from Bingin, Dreamland and Padang Padang — easy to drop in after your session. See also sun-stressed skin.

### Kobido vs Gua Sha: Which Face Massage Should You Choose?
Choose Kobido if you want a lifting, toning effect: it uses fast, rhythmic lifting motions and percussive tapping and is known as the "natural facelift". Choose Gua Sha if you want relaxation and gentle drainage: smooth stones glide over the face to release tension and depuff. For deep jaw tension, add a Buccal Massage.

Kobido: the Japanese natural facelift Kobido is a centuries-old Japanese facial massage. Its techniques are fast and precise: deep lifting strokes, lymphatic drainage and percussive tapping that stimulate circulation and tone the facial muscles. At POINT · FACE we perform it with our collagen cream. Kobido Massage: 30 min IDR 500,000 · 60 min IDR 850,000. Gua Sha: the relaxing, depuffing ritual Gua Sha comes from traditional Chinese medicine. A smooth stone is glided along the face and neck with oil to release muscle tension and encourage lymphatic drainage. We use centella oil to soothe the skin. Gua Sha Massage: 30 min IDR 350,000. Comparison KobidoGua Sha Main goalLift & toneRelax & depuff RhythmFast, dynamicSlow, flowing ToolsHandsGua Sha stones Best forLoss of firmness, tired featuresStress, puffiness, tension The third option: buccal massage If tension sits deep in your jaw — clenching, grinding — the Buccal Massage works the muscles from inside the mouth. Add it to either massage. Our recommendation Before an event: Kobido 60 min + Buccal. After a stressful week: Gua Sha or the Relaxation Ritual. Living in Bali: a 3-session massage package at 20% off.

### Buccal Massage in Bali: What It Is, What to Expect & Results
Buccal massage is an intra-oral facial massage: with gloved hands, the therapist works the jaw and cheek muscles from inside the mouth as well as outside, reaching deep muscles a regular face massage cannot. It releases jaw tension from clenching, drains puffiness and gives a more sculpted contour — with no needles or filler. At POINT · FACE it takes 15 minutes and can be added to any facial.

How does buccal massage work? "Buccal" refers to the cheek. Your therapist, wearing medical gloves, places one hand inside the mouth and one outside, working the buccinator (cheek muscle), the masseter (the powerful chewing muscle that tightens when you clench) and the surrounding fascia. Combined with lymphatic drainage, this releases tension and lets the face look more defined. What does it feel like? Unusual at first, then deeply relieving. The pressure is intense rather than painful, especially on the masseter if you clench or grind. Your therapist checks the pressure with you throughout. Results A relaxed jaw and less facial tightness Reduced puffiness A more sculpted cheek and jawline contour Better circulation and a healthy glow Results are visible immediately and build with regular sessions. Who should avoid buccal massage? Skip it if you have had recent dental work or oral surgery, have mouth ulcers, an active cold sore or an oral infection. Tell us about braces, implants or a jaw condition (TMJ) before booking. Best combinations Add the Buccal Massage to the Advanced Collagen Booster for maximum definition, or pair it with a Kobido Massage for a full natural facelift session. ### What Is a PDRN (Salmon DNA) Facial? Benefits, Results & Who It's For
PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a purified DNA fragment, usually extracted from salmon, used in Korean dermatology to support skin repair and regeneration. In a non-invasive PDRN facial it is applied topically in serums and masks and driven deeper with ultrasound — no needles — to calm redness, strengthen the skin barrier and help stressed skin recover.

What is PDRN? PDRN stands for polydeoxyribonucleotide — short chains of DNA purified from salmon (or trout) sperm cells. It has been studied for years in wound healing and is widely used by Korean dermatologists, both injected ("skin boosters") and in topical skincare. It is often called the "salmon DNA" or "salmon sperm" facial on social media. How our PDRN facial works Our PDRN Cellular Repair Facial is a non-invasive Korean Hydrafacial. There are no injections and no downtime: Gentle hydrodermabrasion to cleanse and prepare the skin. Ultrasonic infusion of a PDRN pink peptide serum and hyaluronic acid. Oxygen therapy, high frequency and microcurrent. A Rose PDRN mask and red LED to support regeneration. Benefits you can expect A calmer, less reactive complexion with reduced redness A stronger skin barrier that holds hydration better Faster recovery after sun, travel, stress or breakouts Healthier, more resilient-looking skin Topical PDRN is not the same as injectable PDRN: it is gentler and focused on the skin's surface layers. If you want a more intense medical treatment, ask a dermatologist. Who is it for? Ideal for sensitive and reactive skin, sun-exposed skin and dehydrated skin, or anyone whose skin feels "stressed" after a long trip. Who should avoid it: anyone with a fish or salmon allergy. Tell us about pregnancy, medical treatments or reactions during your skin analysis.

### How Often Should You Get a Facial in Bali's Climate?
In Bali's hot, humid and sunny climate, most people benefit from a professional facial every 3–4 weeks — roughly one skin-renewal cycle. For a specific concern such as acne or pigmentation, a series of 3 sessions spaced 2–3 weeks apart works best, followed by maintenance every 4–8 weeks. If you are visiting, book one facial early in your trip and one before you fly home.

Why every 3–4 weeks? Skin renews itself roughly every 28 days in young adults, and more slowly with age. Booking a facial at the rhythm of that cycle clears built-up dead cells and congestion before they dull the skin. In the tropics, heat, sweat and sunscreen speed up congestion — so regular deep cleansing matters even more. If you are on holiday Book a hydrating or repairing facial in your first days to undo the flight, and a glow facial before you fly home. If you surf every day, add a Cryo Skin Reset midway. Can you over-do facials? Yes — too much exfoliation weakens the barrier. Leave at least two weeks between exfoliating facials, and tell your therapist about retinoids or acids you use at home. Massages such as Kobido or Gua Sha are non-exfoliating and can be enjoyed weekly.

### Why Does My Skin Get Dehydrated in Bali — and Which Facial Helps?
Skin gets dehydrated in Bali because of a chain of stressors: dry cabin air on the flight, strong UV, salt water, wind and nights in air-conditioning. They pull water from the outer layers and weaken the barrier. A hydrating facial that infuses humectants and repairs the barrier — such as a Korean Hydrafacial or a PDRN repair facial — restores comfort and glow in one session.

Dehydrated vs dry skin Dry skin is a skin type: it produces less oil. Dehydrated skin is a temporary condition: it lacks water. Even oily skin can be dehydrated — it feels tight after cleansing, looks dull and may produce more oil to compensate. Signs include fine "crêpey" lines when you gently pinch the cheek, make-up that clings to patches and a lack of bounce. Five reasons Bali dehydrates your skin The flight. Cabin humidity is very low; after a long-haul trip your skin has already lost water before you land. UV. Near the equator, UV is strong all year. Sun exposure damages the barrier that keeps water in. Salt water and wind. Surfing, swimming and scooter rides dry the skin surface. Air-conditioning. Moving between humid heat and cold, dry AC day and night is tough on the barrier. Holiday habits. Less water, more sun, cocktails at sunset and over-cleansing after the beach. Which facial is best for dehydrated skin? A good hydrating facial does two things: it delivers water-binding ingredients deep into the skin, and it repairs the barrier so the water stays. Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift — hyaluronic acid, snail mucin and peptides infused with ultrasound; instant plump, glass-skin effect. PDRN Cellular Repair (Salmon DNA) — for dehydrated skin that is also red, sensitive or stressed. Cryo Skin Reset — when dehydration comes with heat after a day in the sun. Hydrating Ritual — Rose & Aloe — a 100% natural, gentle option. Add an Egyptian Rose HydroJelly mask to seal in hydration. Your Bali hydration routine Cleanse gently — skip foaming, stripping cleansers. Apply a hydrating serum on damp skin, then a moisturiser to seal it. SPF 50 every morning; reapply after swimming. Rinse off salt water and drink water through the day. Read more in our guide to dehydrated skin in Bali.

### Korean Hydrafacial vs Hydrafacial vs Manual Facial: Which Is Best for You?
A classic Hydrafacial is a device-led protocol: hydrodermabrasion to cleanse, extract and infuse serums. A Korean Hydrafacial uses the same technology but adds a multi-step Korean skincare ritual — layered K-beauty actives, masks and massage — for a hydrated "glass skin" finish. A manual facial uses hands and natural products only: more sensory and relaxing, with gentler, shorter-lived results. For visible glow and deep cleansing in Bali's climate, the Korean Hydrafacial gives the best of both.

What is a Hydrafacial? A Hydrafacial is a non-invasive facial performed with a hydrodermabrasion device. A spiral-tipped handpiece uses water and gentle suction (a "vortex") to exfoliate dead cells, loosen and extract what clogs the pores, and infuse serums at the same time. It is fast, painless and has no downtime. A classic Hydrafacial follows a set protocol: cleanse and exfoliate, extract, hydrate. What is a Korean Hydrafacial? A Korean Hydrafacial keeps the hydrodermabrasion technology and builds a Korean skincare ritual around it: double cleansing, essences and ampoules applied in thin layers, ultrasonic infusion, a sheet or HydroJelly mask and plenty of massage. The actives are typical of K-beauty — snail mucin, centella asiatica, propolis, niacinamide, peptides, hyaluronic acid — from brands such as COSRX, SKIN1004, Beauty of Joseon, Mediheal and Medicube. The goal is the famous glass skin: clean, plump, luminous. At POINT · FACE, our systems also include oxygen, radiofrequency, microcurrent, high frequency, a cold hammer and LED, so each Korean Hydrafacial is tailored to a concern. ### What Is Glass Skin — and Can a Facial Give It to You?
Glass skin is a Korean beauty term for skin so hydrated, smooth and clear that it looks translucent and reflects light like glass. It rests on three pillars: deep hydration, refined texture (clean pores, no build-up) and a healthy barrier. A Korean Hydrafacial delivers all three in one session — the glow is visible immediately and lasts about a week.

Where does "glass skin" come from? The term comes from Korea, where skincare focuses on prevention and hydration rather than coverage. Glass skin is not a filter or a make-up look — it is skin in excellent condition: plump with water, smooth, even and luminous. The 3 pillars of glass skin Hydration — humectants such as hyaluronic acid and snail mucin plump the skin so it reflects light. Texture — clean, refined pores and no dead-cell build-up for a smooth surface. Barrier — centella, peptides and propolis keep the skin calm and able to hold water. How our glass-skin facial works The Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift is our signature 80-minute protocol with 18+ steps: double cleansing, hydrodermabrasion, extraction, ultrasonic infusion of a 6-peptide booster, snail mucin and hyaluronic acid, oxygen therapy, high frequency, cold hammer, red & green LED and a hydrogel mask. Features COSRX, SKIN1004 and Beauty of Joseon. How to keep it Layer light hydration: toner, essence, serum, moisturiser. Exfoliate gently once or twice a week. SPF 50 every day — the most important anti-dullness step in Bali. More in dull skin & glass skin.

For a wedding in Bali, start 2–3 months before with a series of targeted facials (acne, pigmentation or firmness), keep a monthly hydrating facial, then book your final glow facial 2–5 days before the ceremony — never the day before. In Uluwatu, our Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift or Ultimate Glass Skin plus a Buccal Massage give maximum lift and glow with no redness on the day.

Three sessions spaced 2–3 weeks apart. 1 month before: hydrate and firm Switch to hydration and glow with the Ultimate Korean Glass Skin. Avoid trying new products or strong at-home peels from now on. 2–5 days before: the final glow Book the Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift or the Ultimate Glass Skin, plus a Buccal Massage for a sculpted jawline in photos. The timing leaves your skin glowing with zero risk of residual redness. The day before Keep it simple: a Kobido or Gua Sha massage to depuff, collagen eye patches, plenty of water and an early night.
